create_subclass_BaseModel: create a subclass of BaseModel that implements set_input, forward, and optimize_parameters methods
test_BaseModel_forward: test the BaseModel forward pass by calling model.test() which runs forward under no_grad context
save_networks_BaseModel: save all network checkpoints to disk by calling model.save_networks(epoch) with the current epoch number
load_networks_BaseModel: load all network checkpoints from disk by calling model.load_networks(epoch) with the saved epoch suffix
update_learning_rate_BaseModel: update learning rates for all optimizers by calling model.update_learning_rate() at the end of each epoch
